channel.title: Engineering Notebook
channel.description: Engineering notes on data systems, AI agents, and the tools I build to understand them.

item.title: Agent skills field guide: what to use, where to find them, what to build
item.description: Anatomy of an agent skill, a checklist mapping tasks to skills from a real inventory, how local skills compare to Claude conventions, and which custom skills are worth building.

item.title: I Let the Browser Award XP. That Was a Mistake.
item.description: The data-eng-mastery app once trusted Priya's browser to award experience points. Browsers can lie. The story of BUG-017: what I assumed, what broke, and why the server owns rewards now.

item.title: Two Codebases, One Argument: The Dashboard 500 and the Drift Behind It
item.description: A dashboard that 500'd on every load, practice feedback showing blanks, a leaderboard that couldn't count — eight contract-drift sites in data-eng-mastery, one missing guardrail.

item.title: The First Customer Crashed Checkout: Five Paths Nobody Ever Ran
item.description: A NameError on first subscription, a GDPR delete that selected instead of deleting, a fake export URL, a missing exam column — data-eng-mastery's unexecuted paths, fixed and one still open.

item.title: Green Tests, Red Services: The Suite Passed and the Backend Still Disagreed
item.description: Eighteen failing tests fixed to 86/86 in data-eng-mastery — and the service-layer drift the suite didn't catch: stale columns, duplicate SM-2 math, a canonical module nobody calls.

item.title: Nobody Could Log In: Four Bugs Wearing a Trenchcoat
item.description: Tokens that were always null, a guard that bounced everyone, a login body that serialized to '{}', and a refresh flow that never fired — the data-eng-mastery auth saga.

item.title: The Plan Said Done: A Hardening That Exists Mostly as Checkmarks
item.description: A leaked API key still in config, token hardening absent from every branch, pipeline stubs reporting zeros — and the untracked plan file that marks them all done.

item.title: Two Writes That Silently Discarded You
item.description: A password change that toasted success and changed nothing, and study sessions that saved zeros — data-eng-mastery's silent-write failures (BUG-006, BUG-008).

item.title: I inventoried 80 projects on my own hard drive
item.description: How an exclusion-first PowerShell scanner, deterministic scoring, and honest caveats turned 300 GB of accumulated side projects into a triage-able inventory.

item.title: Postgres for everything: rows, vectors, and text in one store
item.description: Implement hybrid content search without new infrastructure: one similarity query, the dimension contract, and an honest split criterion.

item.title: FastAPI in production: three afternoons to boring reliability
item.description: Move one write server-side, enforce layers with tests, install CI gates — each step grounded in real code from a learning-platform backend.
